quarter.zh: 2027 财年第一季（9 月季度，截至 10 月 2 日）

en: Revenue rose 378% to $11.0B against $10.7B expected, and non-GAAP EPS of $49.51 beat the ~$47.15 consensus, both above the company's own range. Data-center revenue jumped 61% in a quarter to $4.8B, and gross margin edged up to 85.1%. The Q2 guide of $12.2–12.6B and $55–57 EPS (pre-split) topped consensus of about $12.3B and $53.3. CEO David Goeckeler said demand keeps growing; CFO Luis Visoso said about half of FY27 bits are under long-term deals and the pipeline exceeds supply through the decade. The board approved an 8-for-1 split.

Shares fell 5.3% to $1,330.05 in the session before the report and swung between about −3% and +3% after hours. On Oct 30 they slid 13.5% to $1,150.89 despite the beat, the higher guide, a $5B quarterly buyback and the 8-for-1 split (split-adjusted trading from Nov 20). After a roughly 460% gain this year, investors questioned how long memory prices can stay this high, a worry sharpened by Intel's warning that memory costs are crushing PC demand; memory peers fell too.
zh: 营收增长 378% 至 110 亿美元，高于 107 亿美元的预期；非 GAAP 每股收益 49.51 美元，高于约 47.15 美元的一致预期，两者均超出公司自身指引。数据中心营收单季环比增长 61% 至 48 亿美元，毛利率小幅升至 85.1%。第二季指引营收 122–126 亿美元、每股收益 55–57 美元（拆股前），高于约 123 亿美元和 53.3 美元的预期。CEO 大卫·格克勒称需求持续增长；CFO 路易斯·维索索表示 FY27 约一半出货位元已纳入长期协议，潜在需求在本十年内都超过供给。董事会批准 1 拆 8 股票分割。

股价在财报前的交易时段下跌 5.3% 至 1,330.05 美元，盘后在约 −3% 与 +3% 之间波动。10 月 30 日，尽管业绩超预期、指引上调、单季回购 50 亿美元并宣布 1 拆 8（11 月 20 日起按拆股后价格交易），股价仍下跌 13.5% 至 1,150.89 美元。在今年累计上涨约 460% 后，投资者质疑内存高价还能维持多久，英特尔关于内存成本重创 PC 需求的警告加剧了这一担忧，内存同业同步下跌。

bio.en: Western Digital CEO from 2020, he led the separation of its flash business and became Sandisk's CEO at the February 2025 spin-off. Before that, nearly two decades at Cisco, latterly running its networking and security business.
bio.zh: 2020 年起任西部数据 CEO，主导闪存业务分拆，2025 年 2 月闪迪独立上市时出任 CEO。此前在思科工作近二十年，最后负责网络与安全业务。

bio.en: CFO since the 2025 spin-off. Previously CFO of Unity Software and of Palo Alto Networks, and earlier CFO of Amazon Web Services and Amazon's worldwide consumer business, after starting at Procter & Gamble.
bio.zh: 2025 年分拆起任 CFO。此前任 Unity Software 和 Palo Alto Networks 的 CFO，更早担任亚马逊 AWS 及全球消费者业务 CFO，职业生涯始于宝洁。
